summary.room_node_rule: Every non-bathroom room must have at least one node.
summary.bathroom_rule: Bathrooms have no node and are covered by corridor/nearest nodes.
summary.rf_assumption_note: RSSI/SNR values are simulation estimates based on distance, wall attenuation, antenna direction, and noise floor.
warnings: Average coverage is below StructFi target 95-99%.
Some nodes are degraded and require review.

constraints.placement_rule: Every non-bathroom room gets at least one corner-based directional node.
constraints.bathroom_rule: Bathrooms get no node and are covered from corridor/nearest node.
constraints.corridor_rule: Corridors are planned as backbone coverage zones.
constraints.rf_model_rule: RSSI/SNR are estimated from log-distance path loss, wall/material attenuation, directional antenna gain, and noise floor.
